govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AutopsyJFKHelpe: Material on the Kennedy autopsy filed under the names Helpern and Houts makes up this document. Dr. Milton Helpern, New York's chief medical examiner, was the most prominent pathologist to criticize the official autopsy from outside it, and his name runs through the medical debate on the case. The file is kept as issued, part of the paper record of the long argument over the autopsy evidence.
